www.ohiosos.gov.es: la Secretaría de Estado de Ohio

codes.ohio.gov.es: el Código Revisado de Ohio (Ohio Revised Code)

boe.cuyahogacounty.gov.en: the Cuyahoga County Board of Elections
boe.cuyahogacounty.gov.es: la Junta Electoral del Condado de Cuyahoga (Cuyahoga County Board of Elections)

reg_deadline.en: Registration closed on Monday, October 5, 2026. Not sure you're registered? Check the Secretary of State's voter lookup.
reg_deadline.es: El registro cerró el lunes 5 de octubre de 2026. ¿No sabes si estás registrado? Revisa la búsqueda de votantes (Voter Lookup) de la Secretaría de Estado.
reg_deadline.quote: Deadline to Register to Vote: October 5 (boards of elections and the Ohio Secretary of State's office are open until 9 p.m.)

mail_request.en: Your county board of elections must receive your absentee ballot application by 8:30 p.m. on Tuesday, October 27, 2026.
mail_request.es: La junta electoral de tu condado (county board of elections) debe recibir tu solicitud de boleta de voto en ausencia a más tardar a las 8:30 p. m. del martes 27 de octubre de 2026.
mail_request.quote: October 27: Absentee ballot applications must be received by your board of elections by 8:30 p.m.
mail_request.en_after: Applications closed at 8:30 p.m. on October 27. You can still vote early in person through Sunday, November 1, or at your polling place on Election Day.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes cerraron a las 8:30 p. m. del 27 de octubre. Todavía puedes votar por anticipado en persona hasta el domingo 1 de noviembre, o en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones.
mail_request.en_after2: Applications closed at 8:30 p.m. on October 27. Vote at your polling place on Election Day.
mail_request.es_after2: Las solicitudes cerraron a las 8:30 p. m. del 27 de octubre. Vota en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones.

mail_return.en: Your county board of elections must receive it by 7:30 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. A postmark isn't enough. Military and overseas deadlines differ.
mail_return.es: La junta electoral de tu condado debe recibirla a más tardar a las 7:30 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre de 2026. No basta con el matasellos. Los plazos para votantes militares y en el extranjero son distintos.
mail_return.quote: November 3: Non-UOCAVA absentee ballots must be received by your board of elections by 7:30PM.

early_hours.en: Wednesday, October 28 to Friday, October 30: 7:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. Saturday, October 31: 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. Sunday, November 1: 1 p.m. to 5 p.m. There's no early voting on Monday, November 2.
early_hours.es: Del miércoles 28 al viernes 30 de octubre: de 7:30 a. m. a 7:30 p. m. Sábado 31 de octubre: de 8 a. m. a 4 p. m. Domingo 1 de noviembre: de 1 p. m. a 5 p. m. No hay votación anticipada el lunes 2 de noviembre.
early_hours.quote: October 28 to 30: 7:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. October 31: 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. November 1: 1 p.m. to 5 p.m.
early_hours.en_after: Sunday, November 1: 1 p.m. to 5 p.m. That's the last day of early voting. There's no early voting on Monday, November 2.
early_hours.es_after: Domingo 1 de noviembre: de 1 p. m. a 5 p. m. Es el último día de votación anticipada. No hay votación anticipada el lunes 2 de noviembre.

cure.notes: The cure deadline is relative (the fourth day after the election, R.C. 3509.06(D)(3)(b)); it is in mail.cure rather than as a computed date here.

in_person.en: Vote early at your county board of elections or the early vote center it lists, through Sunday, November 1. On Election Day, vote at your assigned polling place between 6:30 a.m. and 7:30 p.m.
in_person.es: Vota por anticipado en la junta electoral de tu condado o en el centro de votación anticipada que indique, hasta el domingo 1 de noviembre. El Día de las Elecciones, vota en el lugar de votación que te corresponde entre las 6:30 a. m. y las 7:30 p. m.
in_person.quote: Starting the day after the close of voter registration, registered voters may cast an early in-person ballot at their county board of elections.
in_person.en_after: Early voting ended Sunday, November 1. On Election Day, vote at your assigned polling place between 6:30 a.m. and 7:30 p.m.
in_person.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó el domingo 1 de noviembre. El Día de las Elecciones, vota en el lugar de votación que te corresponde entre las 6:30 a. m. y las 7:30 p. m.

first_time.en: Check your registration and polling place online before you go. Bring an accepted, unexpired photo ID. Changed your name? Bring proof of the change too.
first_time.es: Revisa en línea tu registro y tu lugar de votación antes de ir. Lleva una identificación con foto aceptada y vigente. ¿Te cambiaste el nombre? Lleva también un comprobante del cambio.
first_time.quote: If your name has changed but your address hasn’t, you can vote a regular ballot by showing proof of your legal name change, such as a marriage license or court order.

locator_label.en: Check your registration and polling place (Ohio Secretary of State)
locator_label.es: Revisa tu registro y tu lugar de votación (Secretaría de Estado de Ohio)

rule.en: On Election Day, vote at the polling place for your precinct. At the wrong one, a poll worker will tell you where to go. If you vote a provisional ballot at the wrong polling place instead, it won't be counted.
rule.es: El Día de las Elecciones, vota en el lugar de votación de tu precinto. Si vas al equivocado, un trabajador electoral te dirá adónde ir. Si en vez de eso votas con una boleta provisional en el lugar equivocado, no se contará.
rule.quote: If an individual cast a provisional ballot in a precinct in which the individual is not registered and eligible to vote and in the incorrect polling location for the precinct in which the individual is registered and eligible to vote, the provisional ballot envelope shall not be opened, and the ballot shall not be counted.

en: Interim ID form from the Ohio BMV
U.S. military ID or military dependent ID
U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs ID
es: Tarjeta de identificación del estado de Ohio
Identificación provisional (interim ID) del BMV de Ohio
Pasaporte o tarjeta pasaporte de EE. UU.
Identificación militar de EE. UU. o identificación de dependiente militar
Identificación de la Guardia Nacional de Ohio (Ohio National Guard)
Identificación del Departamento de Asuntos de Veteranos de EE. UU. (VA)
accepted.quote: To vote, voters must show a valid form of photo identification (ID) that has the voter’s name and photograph, and the identification must not be expired.

expired.en: Your photo ID can't be expired. These don't count: a license or ID from another state, the Ohio Mobile ID, or an Ohio ID marked NON RENEWABLE/NON TRANSFERABLE. An ID marked NONCITIZEN works only with extra proof of citizenship.
expired.es: Tu identificación con foto no puede estar vencida. No sirven: una licencia o identificación de otro estado, la Ohio Mobile ID, ni una identificación de Ohio marcada NON RENEWABLE/NON TRANSFERABLE. Una identificación marcada NONCITIZEN solo sirve junto con otro comprobante de ciudadanía.
expired.quote: Driver license or photo identification that contains a “NONCITIZEN” identifier may be used only in conjunction with additional proof of citizenship.

without.en: No photo ID? You vote a provisional ballot. For it to count, show an accepted ID at your county board of elections within four days after Election Day. If you have no photo ID because of a religious objection, you can sign an affidavit (Form 12-O) instead.
without.es: ¿No tienes identificación con foto? Votas con una boleta provisional. Para que cuente, muestra una identificación aceptada en la junta electoral de tu condado dentro de los cuatro días después del Día de las Elecciones. Si no tienes identificación con foto por una objeción religiosa, puedes firmar una declaración jurada (Form 12-O).
without.quote: In order for the provisional ballot to be eligible to be counted, the voter must present one of the acceptable forms of identification to the board office within four days after Election Day.

who.en: Any registered Ohio voter can vote absentee. You don't need a reason. You have to ask for a ballot, with a separate application for each election.
who.es: Cualquier votante registrado en Ohio puede votar en ausencia. No necesitas dar una razón. Tienes que pedir la boleta, con una solicitud aparte para cada elección.
who.quote: Any registered Ohio voter with up-to-date information can vote absentee. No reason is required to vote absentee in Ohio.

witness.en: Fill in your name and address on the identification envelope, sign it, and give one form of ID: your Ohio driver's license or state ID number, the last four digits of your Social Security number, or a copy of your photo ID. A copy of your ID goes in the return envelope, next to the identification envelope.
witness.es: Escribe tu nombre y dirección en el sobre de identificación (identification envelope), fírmalo y da una forma de identificación: el número de tu licencia de conducir o identificación estatal de Ohio, los últimos cuatro dígitos de tu número de Seguro Social o una copia de tu identificación con foto. La copia de tu identificación va en el sobre de devolución, junto al sobre de identificación.
witness.quote: (3) A copy of the elector's photo identification in the return envelope with the identification envelope.

cure.en: If your identification envelope is incomplete or doesn't match your record, the board mails you a notice. Get the missing information to the board on its form, in person or by mail, by the fourth day after the election.
cure.es: Si tu sobre de identificación está incompleto o no coincide con tu registro, la junta te envía un aviso por correo. Entrega la información que falta a la junta en su formulario, en persona o por correo, a más tardar el cuarto día después de la elección.
cure.quote: The notice shall inform the voter that in order for the voter's ballot to be counted, the voter must provide the necessary information to the board of elections in writing and on a form prescribed by the secretary of state not later than the fourth day after the day of the election.

dropbox.en: Mail it, or hand it in at your county board of elections office or the drop box outside it, by 7:30 p.m. on Election Day. The drop box is open around the clock until then. Don't bring it to a polling place. A near relative can deliver it for you inside the board office and signs a form there (Form 12-P).
dropbox.es: Mándala por correo, o entrégala en la oficina de la junta electoral de tu condado o en el buzón de entrega que está afuera, a más tardar a las 7:30 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones. El buzón está abierto a toda hora hasta entonces. No la lleves a un lugar de votación. Un familiar cercano puede entregarla por ti dentro de la oficina de la junta y firma ahí un formulario (Form 12-P).
dropbox.quote: The return envelope shall be returned by no other person, in no other manner, and to no other location, except as otherwise provided in section 3509.08 of the Revised Code.
dropbox.notes: Statute (effective March 20, 2026, SB 293): mail, deliver to the board office, or listed relatives deliver to the office; (C)(3)(a)-(b) one secure receptacle outside the board office, open at all times from the day after registration closes to 7:30 p.m. Election Day. Form 12-P: Hancock County BOE copy of the SOS form (https://hancockcountyohioelections.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/12-p1.pdf), 'deliver this with the ballot to a board of elections official in the board of elections office.' Lake County BOE (https://www.lakecountyohio.gov/boe/absentee-voting-information/): 'If you are assisting another voter with the return of a ballot, you MUST see a board of elections official.' Drop box for the voter's own ballot only: SOS FAQ 'Only the voter may use the dropbox to return their personal absentee ballot.' Read 2026-10-28.

gear.en: No campaigning between the polling place and the small U.S. flags set about 100 feet out on the walkways. If the line reaches past the flags, the rule covers anyone within 10 feet of it.
gear.es: No se permite hacer campaña entre el lugar de votación y las banderitas de EE. UU. que se colocan a unos 100 pies en los caminos de acceso. Si la fila pasa de las banderas, la regla aplica a menos de 10 pies de cualquier persona en la fila.
gear.quote: Loiter, congregate, or engage in any kind of election campaigning within the area between the polling place and the small flags of the United States placed on the thoroughfares and walkways leading to the polling place, and if the line of electors waiting to vote extends beyond those small flags, within ten feet of any elector in that line;

phone.en: Ohio law makes it a felony to let someone see your ballot with the apparent intent of showing how you're about to vote. No Ohio rule speaks directly to taking a photo of your own ballot, at the polls or at home. Ask a poll worker before you take any photo inside the polling place.
phone.es: La ley de Ohio castiga como delito grave (felony) dejar que alguien vea tu boleta con la intención aparente de mostrar cómo vas a votar. Ninguna regla de Ohio habla directamente de tomarle foto a tu propia boleta, ni en el lugar de votación ni en casa. Pregunta a un trabajador electoral antes de tomar cualquier foto dentro del lugar de votación.
phone.quote: being an elector, allow the elector's ballot to be seen by another, except as provided by section 3505.24 of the Revised Code, with the apparent intention of letting it be known how the elector is about to vote
phone.notes: Searched ohiosos.gov FAQ (phone and photo limits there are for observers only). Statute read 2026-10-28; penalty line: 'Whoever violates this section is guilty of a felony of the fifth degree.'

line.en: Polls close at 7:30 p.m. If you're in line by then, stay put. You have the right to vote.
line.es: Los lugares de votación cierran a las 7:30 p. m. Si estás en la fila a esa hora, no te salgas. Tienes derecho a votar.
line.quote: As long as you are in line by 7:30 p.m., you have the right to vote.

tradition.en: For 2026, the Secretary of State unveiled a limited-edition America 250 "I Voted" sticker for the nation's 250th birthday. Each of Ohio's 88 county boards of elections gets a limited supply for this election. Ohio's earlier sticker came from a 2019 contest for students, won by Emily, a senior at Teays Valley High School in Pickaway County.
tradition.es: Para 2026, la Secretaría de Estado presentó un sticker de "I Voted" de edición limitada de America 250 por los 250 años del país. Cada una de las 88 juntas electorales de condado de Ohio recibe una cantidad limitada para esta elección. El sticker anterior de Ohio salió de un concurso para estudiantes en 2019, que ganó Emily, estudiante de último año en Teays Valley High School, en el condado de Pickaway.
tradition.quote: Each of Ohio's 88 county boards of elections will receive a limited supply of the new stickers for use during the 2026 General Election.
tradition.notes: 2019 winner from https://www.ohiosos.gov/office/media-center/categories/press-releases/2019-05-21 ('more than 15,000 votes were cast for the winner -- Emily Legg, a 12th grader from Teays Valley High School'). She was a high school student when named, so the page uses her first name and school only; surname removed. Votes wording dropped: 15,000 were cast in the vote, not all for her.

early.en: Yes, while supplies last. If you vote in person, early or on Election Day, you get the America 250 "I Voted" sticker from your county's limited supply.
early.es: Sí, mientras haya. Si votas en persona, por anticipado o el Día de las Elecciones, recibes el sticker de "I Voted" de America 250 de la cantidad limitada de tu condado.
early.quote: Voters who cast a ballot in person during early voting or on Election Day will receive the commemorative sticker while supplies last.

mail.en: Cuyahoga County's board of elections offers a digital I Voted! sticker for people who voted by mail. Save it and share it.
mail.es: La junta electoral del condado de Cuyahoga ofrece un sticker digital de I Voted! para quienes votaron por correo. Guárdalo y compártelo.
mail.quote: Click the I Voted! sticker below, save it, and share it on your social media to show your fellow Ohioans that you voted by mail and made your voice heard!

provisional.en: You may get one if your name isn't in the pollbook, you don't have a valid photo ID, you already asked for an absentee ballot, or you moved without updating your registration. It counts once officials confirm you're eligible and voted in the right precinct. Without ID, show one at your county board of elections within four days.
provisional.es: Te la pueden dar si tu nombre no está en el padrón, si no tienes una identificación con foto válida, si ya pediste una boleta de voto en ausencia o si te mudaste sin actualizar tu registro. Se cuenta cuando confirman que tienes derecho a votar y que votaste en el precinto correcto. Si no llevaste identificación, preséntala en la junta electoral de tu condado dentro de cuatro días.
provisional.quote: it’s set aside until election officials confirm that you’re eligible to vote and voted in the correct precinct.

line.en: You can still vote. Anyone in line by 7:30 p.m. on Election Day has the right to vote.
line.es: Todavía puedes votar. Cualquier persona que esté en la fila a las 7:30 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones tiene derecho a votar.
line.quote: As long as you are in line by 7:30 p.m., you have the right to vote.

track.en: Use the Secretary of State's Track Your Ballot page. Pick your county, and it sends you to that county's tracker.
track.es: Usa la página Track Your Ballot de la Secretaría de Estado. Elige tu condado y te lleva a la herramienta de rastreo de ese condado.
track.quote: To track your ballot, please either use the clickable map below or the list of Ohio counties to find the county in which you live.

late_mail.en: Yes, if it can't reach your county board of elections by 7:30 p.m. on November 3. A postmark doesn't count. Hand it in at the board office or its drop box instead. You can't turn it in at a polling place.
late_mail.es: Sí, si no puede llegar a la junta electoral de tu condado antes de las 7:30 p. m. del 3 de noviembre. El matasellos no cuenta. Mejor entrégala en la oficina de la junta o en su buzón de entrega. No puedes entregarla en un lugar de votación.
late_mail.quote: The return envelope shall be returned by no other person, in no other manner, and to no other location, except as otherwise provided in section 3509.08 of the Revised Code.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 in Chrome (ohiosos.gov returns 403 to WebFetch and a security check to curl) and on codes.ohio.gov by curl. Pages: Voting Schedule (text only), Voter ID Requirements, Absentee Voting by Mail, Elections FAQ, Early Voting Locations, Track Your Ballot and Find My Polling Location directories, 2019 sticker press release. EARLY VOTING DATES FOR states.js (Ohio is unchecked): Tuesday, October 6 to Sunday, November 1, 2026, at each county board of elections (Huron County lists an Early Vote Center). Source https://www.ohiosos.gov/elections/voting-schedule-text-only: 'October 6: Early In-Person Voting begins' and 'Early In-Person Voting: Begins October 6 and includes the two Saturdays and the Sunday before Election Day (specific hours below).' Last day per the hours table: 'November 1: 1 p.m. to 5 p.m.' Locator for states.js: https://www.ohiosos.gov/directories/early-voting-locations. The schedule lists one set of hours with no county variation. Mail application deadline: the schedule says received by 8:30 p.m. October 27; the FAQ says 'no later than close of business seven days before Election Day' (same day, the schedule gives the hour). Absentee return: received by 7:30 p.m. on Election Day, no postmark grace for non-UOCAVA ballots. Drop box: the absentee page says 'You or a near relative may deliver your completed ballot to your county board of elections or your county board of elections's drop box' and, two sentences later, 'Only the voter may use the dropbox to return their personal absentee ballot.' That's a conflict on who may use the drop box, so mail.dropbox says neither. R.C. 3509.05(C)(1) lets listed relatives deliver to the board office. Gear: R.C. 3501.35 bars campaigning inside the flags; R.C. 3501.30 places the flags 100 feet out. No official page found on campaign clothing for voters; a 2024 SOS press release on attire (2024-11-01) failed to load. Sticker: the 2019 contest is the only official sticker page found; whether that design is still in use was not confirmed, so the text doesn't say it is.

hours.en: Polling places are open 6:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 6:30 a. m. a 7:30 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: All polling places in Ohio are open from 6:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. on Election Day.
